n-k-k5-01.title: Chizivisiro chinotsigira Minseo here?
n-k-k5-01.goal: Tarisa chirevo cheshamwari nemamiriro ose echizivisiro, kwete rekutanga chete, uye utsanangure mhedzisiro muchiKorea.
n-k-k5-01.material:
'Chizivisiro chepaIndaneti chechitoro nemeseji yeshamwari yako Minseo. Nhasi ndi July 12.

[여름맞이 이벤트 안내]
- 기간: 7월 1일 ~ 7월 15일
- 이벤트 기간에 3만 원 이상 사시면 배송비가 무료입니다.
- 제주·도서산간 지역은 무료 배송 대상이 아닙니다. (배송비 3,000원)
- 할인 쿠폰은 한 번만 쓸 수 있습니다.

민서의 문자: "나 어제 4만 원어치 샀어! 배송비 무료래. 제주도에 계신 우리 할머니 댁으로 보냈는데 잘됐지?"'
n-k-k5-01.prereq.0: Unogona kuverenga 이상, 제외, -(으)면 nezvizivisiro zvipfupi
n-k-k5-01.prereq.1: Unoziva nhamba sa 만 원 ne삼천 원
n-k-k5-01.prereq.2: Unoziva 도서산간 = zvitsuwa zvakadzika nenzvimbo dzemakomo
n-k-k5-01.s.s1.prompt: Kuti utonge kuti chirevo chaMinseo chiri chokwadi here, mitsara ipi yechizivisiro yaunofanira kuenzanisa nemeseji yake? Sarudza yose inokosha.
n-k-k5-01.s.s1.hint.0: Zvokwadi zvipi zviri mumeseji yaMinseo zvinotaurwa nechizivisiro? Tsvaga mutsara wechokwadi chega chega.
n-k-k5-01.s.s1.hint.1: Mutsara wega wega wechizivisiro, bvunza: unoisa mamiriro ekuendesa kwemahara here?
n-k-k5-01.s.s1.r.a: Mutemo wekupon unoreva kuderedzwa kwemitengo. Chirevo chaMinseo chinoreva mutengo wekuendesa, saka mutsara uyu hausarudzi.
n-k-k5-01.s.s1.explain: Chirevo chake chine zvikamu zvitatu: kuti akatenga riini (nguva yeevhenti), zvakawanda sei (30,000 won kana kupfuura) uye kwakatumirwa kupi (mutemo wenzvimbo). Chikamu chimwe nechimwe chinovharwa nemutsara mumwe; mutsara wekupon hauna chekuita nekuendesa.
n-k-k5-01.s.s2.prompt: Chizivisiro chinotsigira chirevo chaMinseo chekuti kuendeswa kwake kwemahara here?
n-k-k5-01.s.s2.hint.0: Tora mamiriro echizivisiro rimwe nerimwe uye utarise rimwe nerimwe nemeseji yake.
n-k-k5-01.s.s2.hint.1: Mamiriro api asati atarisirwa nemeseji yake?
n-k-k5-01.s.s2.o.a: Ehe, asi kana akashandisawo kupon yekudzikisira yekamwe chete.
n-k-k5-01.s.s2.r.a: Kupon chipo chakasiyana; hachisi mamiriro ekuendesa kwemahara.
n-k-k5-01.s.s2.o.b: Hazvizikanwi, nokuti Minseo chete ndiye anoziva zvaakabhadhara chaizvo.
n-k-k5-01.s.s2.r.b: Huwandu huri mumeseji yake, uye chizivisiro chinotumidza nzvimbo dzinobviswa, saka kutonga kunogoneka.
n-k-k5-01.s.s2.o.c: Ehe. Akatenga 40,000 won panguva yeevhenti, saka kuendesa kwemahara.
n-k-k5-01.s.s2.r.c: Akatarisa zuva nehuwandu, asi akamira ipapo. Chizivisiro chine rimwe mamiriro nezvekwaendeswa paketi.
n-k-k5-01.s.s2.o.d: Kwete. Chizivisiro hachipi kuendesa kwemahara kunzvimbo yaakatumira.
n-k-k5-01.s.s2.explain: Kuendesa kwemahara kunoda nguva yeevhenti NEMA30,000 won kana kupfuura NENZVIMBO YEKUENDESA isingabviswi. Minseo anosangana nemaviri ekutanga, asi chizivisiro chinobvisa 제주·도서산간. Kusangana nemamiriro ekutanga hakuiti kuti chirevo chive chokwadi.
n-k-k5-01.s.s3.prompt: Pindura Minseo muchiKorea (kutaura kwemutsa kune hushamwari -요). Taura zvaunofunga nezvemutengo wake wekuendesa uye ipa chikonzero kubva pachizivisiro. ChiRungu chinogamuchirwa kana wakamira.
n-k-k5-01.s.s3.hint.0: Tanga nenzvimbo, wobva wataura zvinoitwa nechizivisiro pazvinhu zvenzvimbo iyoyo.
n-k-k5-01.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ndakazvisimbisa pachizivisiro, kwete pakufungidzira kwangu chete here?
n-k-k5-01.s.s3.model.2: Ndinofunga hazviiti mahara: chizivisiro chinoti Jeju haisipo, saka pangava nemutengo we3,000 won.

n-k-k5-03.title: Kuchengetedza kunokodzera mitemo yose
n-k-k5-03.topic: mamiriro akati panguva imwe chete, rimwe rakavanzika mumashoko
n-k-k5-03.goal: Shandura chizivisiro chine mutemo une negative kuita mamiriro chaiwo, tsvaga kuchengetedza kwakawanda kunogutsa ose, uye uzivise rimwe muchiKorea.
n-k-k5-03.material:
'Uri kuchengetedza basa remuzinda wezvekare kumhuri yako. Chizivisiro chemuzinda nemeseji yatete vako:

[가족 체험 예약 안내]
- 요금: 어른 1명 8,000원, 어린이 1명 5,000원
- 한 번에 4명 이상 6명 이하까지 예약할 수 있습니다.
- 어른이 어린이보다 적으면 안 됩니다.
- 어린이는 1명 이상 있어야 합니다.

이모 문자: "예산은 4만 원까지예요."'
n-k-k5-03.thinking.0: Kuverenga mutemo une negative zvakarurama (적으면 안 되다)
n-k-k5-03.thinking.1: Kugutsa mamiriro akawanda panguva imwe chete
n-k-k5-03.prereq.0: Unoziva nhamba, 명, 원 ne이상 / 이하
n-k-k5-03.s.s1.prompt: Chizivisiro chinoti '어른이 어린이보다 적으면 안 됩니다.' Kuchengetedza kupi kunobvumirwa nemutemo uyu?
n-k-k5-03.s.s1.hint.0: Shandura mutemo kuita mutemo nezvevakuru: 'vakuru havafaniri kuva ... kupfuura vana'.
n-k-k5-03.s.s1.hint.1: Nyora mutemo sekuenzanisa kwenhamba yevakuru nenhamba yevana, wobva waedza pazviitiko apo nhamba mbiri dzakasiyana uye apo dzakaenzana.
n-k-k5-03.s.s1.o.a: Vakuru vakaenzana nevana chaizvo, hapana kusanganiswa kumwe.
n-k-k5-03.s.s1.r.a: Mutemo unorambidza vakuru VASHOMA chete. Vakuru vakawanda zvakanakawo.
n-k-k5-03.s.s1.o.b: Vakuru vakaenzana nevana, kana vakuru vakawanda kupfuura vana.
n-k-k5-03.s.s1.o.c: Vakuru vakawanda kupfuura vana; nhamba imwe chete hairatidzwi.
n-k-k5-03.s.s1.r.c: Nhamba dzakaenzana hadzisi 'vakuru vashoma', saka dzinobvumirwa.
n-k-k5-03.s.s1.o.d: Vana vakawanda kupfuura vakuru; nhamba imwe chete hairatidzwi.
n-k-k5-03.s.s1.explain: '적으면 안 되다' zvinoreva 'havafaniri kuva vashoma'. Saka vakuru >= vana: vakuru vakawanda zvakanaka uye nhamba imwe chete zvakanaka, asi vakuru vashoma hazvibvumirwi.
n-k-k5-03.s.s2.prompt: Tsvaga kuchengetedza 3 kwakasiyana kunotevera mitemo yose yechizivisiro nebhajeti riri mumeseji. a = nhamba yevakuru, c = nhamba yevana.
n-k-k5-03.s.s2.hint.0: Rondedzera mitemo semamiriro mapfupi pa a ne c usati waedza nhamba.
n-k-k5-03.s.s2.hint.1: Edza kuchengetedza kumwe wokutarisa nemutemo mumwe nemumwe pamwe; kana mumwe waramba, chinja a kana c wobva wataura zvakare.
n-k-k5-03.s.s2.hint.2: Tarisa mari yekupedzisira: 8,000 x a + 5,000 x c.
n-k-k5-03.s.s2.fail.c1: 어린이는 1명 이상 있어야 합니다: mwana mumwe zvishoma.
n-k-k5-03.s.s2.fail.c2: 어른이 어린이보다 적으면 안 됩니다: vakuru havafaniri kuva vashoma kupfuura vana.
n-k-k5-03.s.s2.explain: Kuchengetedza kuna shanu kunokodzera: (vakuru 3, mwana 1) 29,000 won; (2, 2) 26,000 won; (4, 1) 37,000 won; (3, 2) 34,000 won; (3, 3) 39,000 won. Chizivisiro nemeseji zvinopa miganhu, kwete odha imwe chete chaiyo.
n-k-k5-03.s.s2.because.prompt: Sarudza kuchengetedza kUMWE kwako wobva wanyora chikumbiro muchiKorea (kutaura kwemutsa -요) kumuzinda: vakuru vangani, vana vangani, nemutengo wose.
n-k-k5-03.s.s2.because.hint.1: Taura huwandu hwose pakupedzisira uye pedzisa ne -요.
n-k-k5-03.s.s2.because.selfAssess.0: Nhamba dzinoenderana nekuchengetedza kumwe kwandakavaka here?
n-k-k5-03.s.s2.because.selfAssess.1: Huwandu hwose hwakarurama here (8,000 pamukuru + 5,000 pamwana)?

n-k-k5-02.title: Hayun anotamisa mashoko emudzidzisi
n-k-k5-02.goal: Enzanisa meseji yakatamiswa nepakutanga, tsvaga mitsara yakachinja zvairevwa, uye uiruramise nemashoko akataurwa.
n-k-k5-02.material:
'Mudzidzisi akapa chizivisiro ichi kukirasi nhasi (China). Hayun aiva mukirasi. 민수 akange asipo ndokumubvunza kuti mudzidzisi akati chii, saka Hayun anomutumira meseji masikati iwayo. (-대 / -래 zvinoreva 'ndakanzwa kuti ...': zvinotamisa mashoko emumwe. 벼룩시장 = flea market.)

[선생님 말씀]
"토요일 학교 벼룩시장은 비가 오면 체육관에서 합니다. 물건은 한 사람이 다섯 개까지 팔 수 있어요. 가격표는 학교에서 준비하니까 안 만들어 와도 돼요. 아침 9시 30분까지 체육관에 물건을 가져다 놓으세요. 팔고 남은 물건은 집에 가져가세요. 참가 신청서는 목요일까지 내세요."'
n-k-k5-02.s.s1.prompt: Meseji yaHayun inofanira kutamisa chaizvo zvakataurwa nemudzidzisi. Mitsara yakawanda inochinja zvirevo zvemudzidzisi. Sarudza imwe yacho.
n-k-k5-02.s.s1.hint.0: Tora meseji yemudzidzisi mutsara nemutsara wotsvaga mutsara unoenderana mumeseji yaHayun.
n-k-k5-02.s.s1.hint.1: Peya yega yega, enzanisa nhamba, mazuva uye kuti zvirevo ndeye 'may', 'must' kana 'need not'.
n-k-k5-02.s.s1.explain: Mitsara 3, 5 ne7 haina kururama. Mutsara 3 unoita 'up to five' (다섯 개까지 팔 수 있어요) kuva 'must sell five'. Mutsara 5 unochinja 9:30 kuita 8:30. Mutsara 7 unochinja nguva yekupedzisira kubva kuChina kuenda kuChishanu. Mimwe mitsara inoenderana namashoko emudzidzisi.
n-k-k5-02.s.s2.prompt: Shanduro ipi yemutsara 3 inotamisa zvakataurwa nemudzidzisi nezvehuwandu hwezvinhu?
n-k-k5-02.s.s2.hint.0: Taura mutsara wemudzidzisi nezvezvinhu nemashoko ako pachako kutanga: shanu ndiyo yepamusoro, yepasi kana nhamba chaiyo?
n-k-k5-02.s.s2.hint.1: Edza sarudzo imwe neimwe nezvirevo izvozvo wobva waenzanisa zviperero (-아/어야 하다 ne -(으)ㄹ 수 있다).
n-k-k5-02.s.s2.r.b: Izvi zvinoti unofanira kutengesa shanu chaizvo. Mudzidzisi akapa muganhu, kwete nhamba inodiwa.
n-k-k5-02.s.s2.r.c: 이상 inoita muganhu kuva wepasi, izvo zvakapesana ne 'up to five'.
n-k-k5-02.s.s2.r.d: Izvi zvinoti kutengesa hakubvumirwi zvachose; mudzidzisi akabvumira kusvika shanu.
n-k-k5-02.s.s2.explain: '다섯 개까지 팔 수 있어요' (unogona kutengesa kusvika shanu) inotamiswa se '다섯 개까지 팔 수 있대'. Yepamusoro, yepasi nenhamba chaiyo meseji nhatu dzakasiyana.
n-k-k5-02.s.s3.prompt: Nyora shanduro dzakarurama dzemutsara 5 (nguva yekuuya nezvinhu) nemutsara 7 (nguva yekupedzisira yefomu) muchiKorea sezvaizotumirwa naHayun kuna 민수 (masikati iwayo, achitamisa mashoko emudzidzisi).
n-k-k5-02.s.s3.hint.0: Kopa nhamba nezuva kubva mumeseji yemudzidzisi, kwete kubva mumeseji yaHayun.
n-k-k5-02.s.s3.hint.1: Shandisa mashoko akatamiswa (semuenzaniso -대/-래 kana -라고 했어), sezvairi mumitsara yakarurama.
n-k-k5-02.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Mitsara yangu miviri inopera sezvinoitwa mashoko akatamiswa (-대/-래/-라고 했어) here?
n-k-k5-02.s.s3.selfAssess.1: 민수 aizosvika panguva ndokupa fomu pazuva rakarurama here?

n-k-k5-04.title: Zuva rekupedzisira nderipi?
n-k-k5-04.goal: Verenga meseji yenguva yekupedzisira nechinyoronyoro, sarudza mubvunzo unogadzirisa zvaunofanira kuita, wobva wanyora mubvunzo uyo nemutsa.
n-k-k5-04.material:
'Nhasi ndiMuvhuro, 11월 2일. Mudzidzisi wako anotumira meseji iyi kuhurukuro yekirasi.

선생님: "발표 자료는 금요일 전까지 메일로 보내 주세요. 파일 이름에는 이름을 꼭 써 주세요."

Unorongera kupedza slides dzako neChishanu mangwanani.'
n-k-k5-04.prereq.1: Wakasangana ne 전에 / -까지 nemutauro une rukudzo kana unoremekedza kumudzidzisi
n-k-k5-04.s.s1.prompt: Uri kuronga kupedza maslide ako Chishanu mangwanani. Usati wasarudza, mubvunzo upi wakanakisa kubvunza mudzidzisi?
n-k-k5-04.s.s1.hint.0: Verenga mutsara wenguva yekupedzisira zvishoma nezvishoma. Izwi rimwe riri mukati rinogona kuverengwa nenzira mbiri.
n-k-k5-04.s.s1.hint.1: Mibvunzo ipi inoshandura zvaunoita Chishanu mangwanani?
n-k-k5-04.s.s1.r.a: Huwandu hwemaslide hahusi dambudziko; meseji inosiya mubvunzo wakasiyana wakavhurika.
n-k-k5-04.s.s1.r.b: Meseji yatoti kuti nyora chii mudzinza refaira.
n-k-k5-04.s.s1.r.e: Izvi zvinotora sekuti kutumira Chishanu kunobvumirwa. Ndicho chinhu chaicho chisina kujeka mumeseji.
n-k-k5-04.s.s1.explain: '금요일 전까지' inogona kureva 'kusvika zuva risati rasvika Chishanu' kana 'kusvika Chishanu'. Mudzidzisi chete ndiye anoziva, saka mubvunzo unobatsira ndewekuti Chishanu pachayo chinoverengwa here.
n-k-k5-04.s.s1.acc.0: Mudzidzisi achipindura 'kusvika nguva ipi paChishanu' aizogadzirisa mukuita, asi mubvunzo hautarise kutanga kuti Chishanu chinoverengwa here.
n-k-k5-04.s.s2.prompt: Nyora mubvunzo wako kumudzidzisi muchiKorea (mutauro une rukudzo). Taura nguva yekupedzisira uye utaure zvakajeka zvaunoda kusimbisa.
n-k-k5-04.s.s2.hint.0: Taura mazwi emudzidzisi enguva yekupedzisira, wobva wataura zuva raunganetsekana.
n-k-k5-04.s.s2.hint.1: Taura mudzidzisi (선생님) uye upedzise nemutauro we -요 kana -ㅂ니다.
n-k-k5-04.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Mubvunzo wangu unoratidza kuti ndinoona kuverenga kuviri kunogoneka here?
n-k-k5-04.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Mudzidzisi anogona kuupindura nemutsara mumwe pfupi here?
n-k-k5-04.s.s3.prompt: Mudzidzisi anopindura: '아, 금요일 오전 9시까지요.' Zvakakosha here kubvunza?
n-k-k5-04.s.s3.hint.0: Enzanisa zvawakafungidzira usati wabvunza nemhinduro yawakawana.
n-k-k5-04.s.s3.hint.1: Zvibvunze: mudzidzi akanaka aigona kuverenga meseji nenzira imwe here?
n-k-k5-04.s.s3.o.a: Mudzidzisi akanyora zuva zvisina kururama uye aireva Chitatu.
n-k-k5-04.s.s3.r.a: Hapana chiri mumeseji chinonongedzera Chitatu, uye mhinduro inopa nguva yekupedzisira yeChishanu.
n-k-k5-04.s.s3.o.b: Zvose China neChishanu zvaiva kuverenga kwakakodzera, saka mudzidzisi chete ndiye aigona kusarudza.
n-k-k5-04.s.s3.o.c: '전까지' inogara ichisiya zuva rakataurwa, saka China raiva zuva rekupedzisira.
n-k-k5-04.s.s3.r.c: Mhinduro inoratidza kuti Chishanu mangwanani chakabvumirwa, uye vatauri vazhinji vanoshandisa '전까지' zvisina kunyanya kunatsa. Haisi mutemo wakatarwa.
n-k-k5-04.s.s3.o.d: '까지' inogara ichisanganisira zuva rakataurwa, saka Chishanu chaibvumirwa kubva pakutanga.
n-k-k5-04.s.s3.r.d: Dai izvi zvaigara zvakadaro kwaisave nechikonzero chekubvunza; mhinduro inowedzerawo nguva (오전 9시) isina kumbopiwa nemeseji.
n-k-k5-04.s.s3.explain: Mutsara umwe chete ungareva 'kusvika China' kana 'kusvika Chishanu'. Kuuverenga nenzira imwe chete kwaitora njodzi yefaira rinonoka. Mhinduro inowedzerawo nguva (오전 9시) isina kumbopiwa nemeseji.

n-k-k5-05.title: Kubva pachati cheshamwari kuenda kuziviso yeelevator
n-k-k5-05.goal: Nyora patsva meseji yechati kune vasingazivikanwi uchiwedzera ruzivo rwunogovanwa neshamwari uye uchichinja mutauro.
n-k-k5-05.material:
Iwe nemumwe wako wekugara muri kuita mhemberero yekupinda mumba (집들이) mufurati yenyu 502호 Satidha rinouya, 10월 24일, kubva pa 6 kusvika pa 9 p.m. Wakanyora izvi muchati yeshamwari dzako:

"토욜 저녁에 우리집 파티함ㅋㅋ 좀 시끄러울 듯. 이해 ㄱㄱ"

(ㅋㅋ = kuseka, ㄱㄱ = 'enda / zvakanaka', 토욜 = 토요일.) Zvino unoda kuisa ziviso muelevator yevavakidzani. Vazhinji vakura, uye hauna kusangana nevazhinji.
n-k-k5-05.prereq.1: Wakasangana ne 양해, 죄송, 부탁 kana unogona kudzidza kubva mumazano
n-k-k5-05.s.s1.prompt: Shamwari dzinoziva kwaunogara uye nguva yemhemberero. Vavakidzani vasina kumbosangana newe havazivi. Ziviso yeelevator inofanira kuwedzera zvinhu zvipi? Sarudza zvese zvinoshanda.
n-k-k5-05.s.s1.hint.0: Fungidzira uchiverenga meseji yechati semuvakidzani: ungaramba usingazivi chii?
n-k-k5-05.s.s1.hint.1: Vavakidzani vangavhiringidzika nenzwi guru. Vaizoda kunzwa chii kubva kwauri?
n-k-k5-05.s.s1.o.b: Mhemberero inotanga rinhi uye inopera rinhi
n-k-k5-05.s.s1.r.c: Vavakidzani havadi menyu kuti vanzwisise ziviso.
n-k-k5-05.s.s1.explain: Vavakidzani vanofanira kuziva kuti ndiani ari kuita ruzha (furati), kwenguva yakadini (kutanga nekupera), uye kuti unovaremekedza (kukumbira ruregerero nekukumbira). Menyu nerondedzero yevaeni zvinofarirwa neshamwari chete.
n-k-k5-05.s.s2.prompt: Mudzidzi mumwe akanyora dhirafiti yekutanga yeziviso. Mutsara mumwe hauna kukodzera vavakidzani vausingazivi, kusanganisira vakuru. Uusarudze.
n-k-k5-05.s.s2.hint.0: Verenga mutsara mumwe nemumwe semuvakidzani mukuru. Upi unonzwika sewashamwari?
n-k-k5-05.s.s2.hint.1: Tarisa kuti zvimwe zvikumbiro mudhirafiti zvakanyorwa sei.
n-k-k5-05.s.s2.explain: Mutsara 4 unokumbira vavakidzani chimwe chinhu nenzira yakapfava yakajairika ('이해해 줘요'). Kune vanhu vausingazivi, kumbira ne '주세요 / 주시면 감사하겠습니다', semuenzaniso '이해해 주시면 감사하겠습니다'.
n-k-k5-05.s.s3.prompt: Zvino nyora ziviso yese iwe pachako muchiKorea yeelevator. Isa furati rako, nguva dzekutanga nekupera, nekukumbira ruregerero kana kunzwisiswa. Shandisa mutauro une rukudzo wezviziviso.
n-k-k5-05.s.s3.hint.0: Tanga nekukwazisa nefurati rako, sezviri muziviso chaiyo.
n-k-k5-05.s.s3.hint.1: Isa zvokwadi (rinhi, chii) mumutsara mumwe, wobva waisa kukumbira ruregerero mumutsara unotevera.
n-k-k5-05.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Muvakidzani asina kumbosangana neni aizoziva furati rakaniko uye kuti rinopera rinhi here?
n-k-k5-05.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Chikumbiro changu chinonzwika neruremekedzo kumunhu mukuru here?
